{{Quote|With all due respect, m'lady, isn't this exactly what Captain Typho told us ''not'' to do?''"<br />"''He thinks we should leave the dangerous work to the Jedi and the clones. But Sheltay, we can't just sit back and let others defend our freedoms for us.''"<br />"''I wholeheartedly&mdash;''hyaa!''&mdash;agree.|Sheltay Retrac and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="SG">{{CWACite|7|Spy Girls}}</ref>}}
'''Sheltay Retrac''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who served as the head of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Senatorial aide|aides]] in the closing stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict, she took part in at least two secret missions, one of which aimed at [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|freeing]] the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] from the gaols of [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. With her [[Sheltay Retrac's husband|husband]], an [[Artist/Legends|artist]] from the [[Castle Lands]] of Alderaan, Retrac had [[Reproduction/Legends|given birth]] to a girl named [[Winter Celchu|Winter]].

==Biography==
===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Senator Padmé, do you know who that was?''"<br />"''No.''"<br />"''Passel Argente's uncle! He's probably connected to the Separatists!''"<br />"''Then let's follow them and find out.|Sheltay Retrac and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="SG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Sheltay Retrac came from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose [[Alderaanian/Legends|inhabitants]] had been among the founders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Like many Alderaanian of note, Retrac chose to pursue a public service career. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail]] of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] became [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the main decision-making body of the Republic.<ref name="dbAnt">{{DB|character|bailantilles|Antilles, Bail}}</ref> Eleven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="ROSV">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> while the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had already begun, Organa appointed Retrac head of his senatorial [[Senatorial aide|support staff]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[File:TotallyPracticalSpyOutfits-CWA7.png|thumb|left|180px|Padmé Amidala and Sheltay Retrac teamed up to retrieve critical evidence]]
By the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Retrac was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to a [[Sheltay Retrac's husband|mysterious artist]] living in the [[Castle Lands]] of Alderaan<ref name="SWC" />&mdash;a [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] area covered with millenary [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] hive-mounds.<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> At the beginning of that year, she had just returned from maternity leave, having recently [[Reproduction/Legends|given birth]] to a baby girl named [[Winter Celchu|Winter]].<ref name="SWC" /> She [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|accompanied]] Bail Organa on the planet [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] to meet with [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. Under the pretext of signing a treaty with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Organa wanted to free the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], who was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] on Metalorn. Retrac remained close to the Senator throughout the mission, although she did not take part in the fighting itself, taking cover behind Organa.<ref name="CW:BO">{{CWACite|5|Bailed Out}}</ref>

Shortly afterwards, Retrac joined [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in acquiring proof that Senator [[Bezz Drexx]] was taking bribes from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] by [[Infiltration of Bezz Drexx's tower|infiltrating]] his [[Bezz Drexx's tower|personal tower]]. Amidala and Sheltay Retrac decide to investigate in secret during a gala, separating from the rest of the hosts and infiltrating private areas of the building to gain more information into the matter. Disposing of their dresses, the two women revealed combat bodysuits. They fought their way to Drexx's tower and split up when they found a split end. Eventually, Amidala caught Drexx on the act of accepting a case of [[Gold/Legends|gold]] from the [[Passel Argente's uncle|uncle]] of [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], a Separatist leader. However, the Senator's hidden [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] was noticed by the two corrupt bureaucrats, who sent their guards after her. Amidala escaped the tower while Retrac waited for her outside at the controls of a speeder ready to streak off and vacate the premises.<ref name="SG" />

===Imperial era===
{{Quote|Find the Queen. She must be somewhere in the main residence. Tell her that she is not to leave the residence under any circumstances, and that she is to contact me as soon as possible. Is that understood?|Bail Organa, to Sheltay Retrac and Celana Aldrete|<ref name="RoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
On the fifth month of 19 BBY,<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> the Clone Wars were brought to an end. However, the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], leader of the Republic, refuse to relinquish his emergency powers. Instead, he [[Declaration of a New Order|announced]] the transformation of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|First Galactic Empire]] and ordered the elimination of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Subsequently, Sheltay Retrac followed Bail Organa on his consular [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], in an attempt to locate survivors of the [[Order 66/Legends|massacre]].<ref name="ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[File:Winter_like_mother.png|thumb|150px|Winter, on the left, dressed very much like her mother]]
Soon after those events, Retrac accompanied Organa to the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], where the Senator lived with his wife, the [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]], and his newly adopted daughter [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]]. The senator of the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]], [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], was branded a traitor to the Empire, and took refuge in the Palace. When the Emperor sent his dreaded second-in-command [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to investigate the presence of Fang Zar on Alderaan, Sheltay Retrac was tasked with getting the Queen to safety.<ref name="RoDV" />

===Legacy===
More than a decade later, in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], Winter wore a [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Clothing/Legends|robe]] and sported a [[Hair/Legends|hairstyle]]<ref name="AotE6">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref> very reminiscent to that of her [[Parent/Legends|mother]]<ref name="SWC" /> on the occasion of the [[25th anniversary of the settling of the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention|25th anniversary]] of the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]].<ref name="AotE6" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|So did we save the day, Padmé?''"<br />"''Oh, I think we did all right&mdash;for a couple of girls.''"<br />"''<nowiki />''Ha ha ha!''|Sheltay Retrac and Padmé Amidala|<ref name="SG" />}}
Sheltay Retrac was a slender, [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned woman with brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She had dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that she kept long<ref name="CSWE" /> following an Alderaanian custom.<ref name="TCS">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>

Retrac had a close bond with the Senator Organa, who did not hesitate to shield her from blaster shots and take her by the hand during flight from dangerous situations.<ref name="CW:BO" /> Their good relationship was also underscored when the Senator accepted to take care of his late friend's daughter.<ref name="SWC" /> In the last year of her existence, Retrac was also on first name terms with Senator Amidala of Naboo.<ref name="SG" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Well, I certainly didn't come to this party for the conversation.''"<br />"''Then it's time to lose these party dresses&hellip;and get serious.|Sheltay Retrac and Padmé Amidala, adopting their spy outfits|<ref name="SG" />}}
While serving Bail Organa at the end of the Clone Wars, Retrac wore a tight-fitting white dress that revealed her shoulders,<ref name="SWC" /> the color of which symbolized her belonging the Alderaanian [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadorial]] community.<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> On one occasion, when going undercover, Retrac ditched her dress in favor of a black garment, gray gloves, a utility belt, and a holster.<ref name="SG" /> Although she belonged to a fundamentally pacifist people,<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Retrac carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]].<ref name="dbShel" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Warrenfu-costume.jpg|thumb|180px|[[Warren Fu]]'s design for Padmé Amidala's costume, which became Sheltay]]
Sheltay Retrac first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the last installment of the Star Wars prequel trilogy, in which she was portrayed by Brazilian model and actress [[Caroline de Souza Correa]]. The dress worn by Retrac was designed by Warren Fu, who worked as art director of visual effects in the prequel; the dress was originally meant for [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], in order to reflect the white costumes worn by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and Amidala's [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] suit. When the design was rejected for Amidala, whose clothing needed to conceal her pregnancy, Fu's design was reassigned to Retrac.<ref name="Art of ROTS">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

In the novel in ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', the character was erroneously referred to as "Sheltray Retrac,"<ref name="RoDV" /> and her irises were mistakenly colored blue in at least one panel of ''[[Bailed Out]]'', a story from ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 5]]''.<ref name="CW:BO" />
